ops.text: Do you want to return to the surface?
Two guards spot you and attack.  But not before sounding the alarm!
You easily dispatch the two sentries.  Hopefully no one will answer the alarm too quickly.  It is best to keep moving.  This area will be crawling with guards shortly.
The two guards don't bother getting up.  "I've told you guys before I can't get ya any more soap without a requisition from the captain!  Wha....hey.....you're not Griloch!!"  They attack!
On the bodies you discover a set of keys marked "supply only."
With key in hand and guards dispatched you head on your way.
A well stocked equipment room.  A sign on the wall reads, "Lock the door when you leave."  You may take whatever you need.
An empty storage room.  Dust covers the floor.  Someone forgot to lock the door.  This seems to be a safe place to keep your stuff, granted you remember to lock the door!!!
Several types of weapons and shields are stored here.  A sign on the wall reads, "REMEMBER to LOCK THE DOOR!!!"
There was a reason this door was doubly protected.  The captains treasure is stored here.
"All right, you guys.  You know ya cannot enter the jail without permission from the Lieutenant.  Now get outta here!"  Do you stay and fight him?
You note that all of the cell doors lock on the outside by the bar across the door method.  No keys are needed.
The guards let you pass.
A crazed man attacks you as soon as the door is opened.

An older man is asleep on the floor.  He looks roughed up, but in fine health for his age.  He awakes and springs to his feet, "So, you are here to save us all?  Good.  That is good.  Thyrr is up to this, isn't he?  Good man.  Anyway, I must warn him.....

...The Griloch know of his plot and are going to strike against him before he can act.  I must go now.  Thank you.  Here, I've been hiding this for months."  He reaches under his straw mat and tosses you a crumpled piece of parchment.

An old man in flowing robes is mumbling something about barrels and horses.  You are completely confused by this mans rambling.  He introduces himself.  "I am Zulea.  A powerful cleric I am.  I would have freed myself if it wasn't for the....

...large dwarf that has been sleeping in the warhorses barrel over there.  Snores too loud."  What would Thyrr want with this man?  You explain to him that he is needed and he agrees to meet you at Thyrrs house.
An empty cell.
A storage room stands unguarded.  There are ample supplies here.
A group of rats was devouring some garbage, until they saw you.  They attack with hunger in their eyes.
A storage area and weapons cache.
The kitchen.  Plenty of food to go around.  One lone guard is here eating.  He sees someone enter and runs out the other door his mouth stuffed.
Two guards are standing here.  They attack you on sight.
Kayvons office.  This simple room contains nothing but a desk and chair.  Would you like to search it?

In the desk you find a stack of papers.  You discover he was telling the truth about the Griloch offer.  The top paper on the stack was the treaty proposal he spoke of, still awaiting his signature.  You also discover some personal journal....

...entries.  They read, "I tire of war with the humans.  I must have peace with them.  My men are restless and untrusting but I must convince them to try peace, for we must not fall in league with the Griloch.  I must succeed with the humans."
The kitchen.  Plenty of food to go around.  One lone guard is here eating.  He sees someone enter and runs out the other door his mouth stuffed.
The contingent of guards looks you over, but lets you pass.
Through slits in the door to the north, you notice there seems to have been much activity in the room.
You surprise a large patrol of Griloch Guards.  "Have at you.....the Berhune raiders attack violently."  You join them!
"Excellent work men!  We have prevailed.  This has been a great victory for our cause!"  The Berhune men sneak back to the camp.  "We will meet with you back at the commanders office!"  They leave.
Three guards are beating up two crazy men who have somehow escaped from the prison.  Will you give the crazy men a hand?
A Lieutenant is trying to rally some argumentative troops.  Your presence has given them something to rally around!  They attack!
A small round object is lying in the corner.  Would you like to take it?
Guard barracks.  There are some guards here.  They notice you are not Griloch and attack.
The guards activity room.  Cards and dice litter the room along with left over food and drink.  No one is here right now.

You have interrupted a meeting of some sort.  There are 3 griloch fighters, 2 captains, 3 mages, a couple of clerics, a lieutenent, a general and several very large fighters.  Tresandra's father is also here!  One of the mages sees you, ...

...and yells out some very strange words.  All of a sudden there is a blinding flash.  When you regain your vision, the general and Tresandra's father are gone!  The remaining entourage attack quite heartily.
The Griloch General has left a suit of armor here... unattended.
The lieutenents sleeping room.  He is currently not here.  There is a roll-top desk, bed, chair, and chest in the room.
Would you like to search the room?
The contingent of guards looks you over, but lets you pass.
A smallish temple area.  There are Griloch clerics here preforming religious rituals over a black obsidian alter.  The alter pulsates with a strong magical aura.  The clerics spot you and attack.
Sleeping quarters.  Presently no one is here.

Guard sleeping quarters.  Two guards are asleep and two are awake.  The awake ones attack while the other two try to get to their feet and help.  All they manage to do is get on the helmet & boots before you are on them!
"Friends, you may move on."  A lone guard lets you pass seeing you wear the Necklace of Griloch.
You discover the reason for so many guards in the area.  Treasure room.  While digging through the treasure, you hear more guards rush into the room you just came from.
"Ah, friends."  The guards let you pass seeing you bear the Necklace of Griloch.

A Berhune guard approaches, "Hurry up, hurry up.  Get in here and close the door.  I see by the necklace you bear that you are followers of Berhune.  You may rest here anytime you wish.  We also have a well stocked supply room which you...

...are welcome to use.  If you are in need of any healing, our clerics will aid you in that as well.  Please, make yourselves at home.  This place has not yet been discovered by the Griloch and we would like to keep it that way."  He leaves.

The captains quarters and office.  Two guards flank the doorway to the left and right.  The captain is seated directly across from you behind a huge oaken desk.  He barely acknowledges your presence.  One of the guards clears...

...his throat and the captain looks up.  "Oh, excuse me gentlemen.  So much to do these days.  My name is Terderas.  I am the captain in commmand of this secret garrison.  Our mission is to monitor the Griloch movements and discover if they...

...are acting alone or not.  Some of us beleive they are actually being ordered by someone higher.  Others beleive they are a loose band of thugs bent on following the Griloch Shaman Klorenz.  I am not sure as of yet, but I will find out.  Our second...

...objective is to quietly dispose of as many Griloch as we can without being detected.  As a matter of fact, I am sending our men to eliminate a storeroom full of Griloch right now.  Pay is 3000gp.  Care to join them?
"Great.  Meet my men at the secret entrance and they will lead you to the sleeping quarters.  Thank you and good luck.  Return here when you complete your mission."
The Berhune sleeping quarters.  A few cots are here and there, but you can tell these men are use to fighting and sleeping in adverse conditions.
A group of guards nod at you as you pass them in the hallway.
A large contigent of Berhune are here.  There are several stockpiles of equipment and food, all of which is being checked in by one of the guards.
A sparsely fitted bedroom is all that the Berhune can offer you.  But you are sure  this is a safe place to rest.
A clerk greets you.  "Hey there.  Go ahead and help yourselves.  I'll keep track of what ya take so don't hesitate."
A Cleric of Berhune greets you warmly, "Friends.  Welcome to our temple.  What may I help you with?"

You meet the Captains men here as you promised.  The largest of the small men speaks, "We go now to serve Berhune, god of peace and harmony.  Make sure your weapons are ready and armor is secure.  Make these Griloch scum pay for their...
...attrocities against good people like those at Mountain View.  We will prevail in this battle!"  His men rally at his speech.  You too are moved by his sincerity.  You move against the Griloch.
A one-way trap door is atop this set of steps.  Would you like to return to the surface?
One of the guards has stashed away his goods behind a loose stone on the wall!

A booming voice rips through your chest.  "Who dare enter the hall of Julioach?  Say now that that no one knows and you shall pass.  Beware, sayeth the wrong word and pay with your lives."  What will you say?
This door hangs open.  Beyond are piles and pile of gems and jewels and gold.  Help yourself.

The stash.  You sense a powerful magical aura from the treasure.  There is a seperate pile which contains 1000 g.p. with a note on it which reads, "Payment to Monks."  Which pile would you like to pilfer?
You take the 1000 g.p. marked as payment for the monks and head on your way.
A low rumbling begins above you as a huge fireball explodes about head level.
Pelting from above is all you feel as large hail stones pummel you.  You get the feeling you did not say the right thing.
Not possible!  From above you the crackling of lightning streaks in your direction.  Now you are sure you said the wrong thing.
The booming voice returns, "Fools.  I allowed you to pass just to be witness to your pitiful deaths.  Now, meet your destruction at the hands of my mentor."
A Griloch Patrol!!!
A tremendous fireball rolls by you but does not detinate.
Large hail stones thunder toward you but dissipate inches from your head into harmless puffs of vapor.
Lightning cracks harmlessly overhead.
In front of you a huge undead skeletal giant patrols the hallway.   Pacing back and forth it gives you no notice.
The two hulking guards at this door point you to the east.  It is obvious you may not pass.
This door leads to the outside.  Would you like to leave the castle?
This room is the liquor storage area.  There are literally hundreds of bottles of wine stacked in rows from floor to ceiling.  There is no one guarding them.
A lever is in the up position here.  Would you like to pull it down?
Would you like to return to the surface?
You easily locate the Griloch treasure stash.  Some treasure!!!!  Make that lots of treasure.

Thyrr stops.  "Behind these doors are the Griloch troops.  Prepare yourselves now friends, for once we open these doors......", Thyrr simply shakes his head and looks skyward for guidance.  Are you ready to open the doors now?
